shots.prompt: Low-angle shot, dim candlelight flickering across ornate imperial dragon-carved pillars and heavy crimson silk bed curtains in the emperor's night chamber. A woman in a vivid red qipao-style gown with gold phoenix embroidery kneels on jade floor tiles, her black hair piled high with jade hairpins, lips painted deep vermilion, eyes lined with kohl, expression both seductive and tense. Smoke curls from bronze incense burners. Cinematic lighting, rich shadows, Tang-inspired palace interior.
